title: Sparse Recovery Bird's-Eye View Model Soup for Robust Camera-Based 3D Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.34976v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Camera-based bird's-eye view (BEV) perception methods such as Fast-BEV have demonstrated promising results with fast inference speed and competitive accuracy. However, their robustness to real-world corruptions remains insufficiently explored, posing risks for autonomous driving deployment where environmental variations are inevitable. In this paper, we propose Sparse Recovery Bird's-Eye View Model Soup (SR-BEVS), a sparse recovery learning approach that simultaneously improves clean accuracy and corruption robustness without requiring additional data or architectural modifications. Our method identifies pruning candidates based on layer-wise weight magnitudes, applies random pruning to create diverse sparse models, and retrains each model with a randomly sampled learning rate. translated_title: 用于鲁棒相机3D目标检测的稀疏恢复鸟瞰图模型汤
translated_abstract: 以Fast-BEV为代表的基于相机的鸟瞰图（BEV）感知方法已展现出令人瞩目的成果，兼具快速的推理速度和具有竞争力的准确率。然而，它们对真实世界损坏的鲁棒性仍未得到充分探索，这在环境变化不可避免的情况下为自动驾驶部署带来了风险。在本文中，我们提出了稀疏恢复鸟瞰图模型汤（SR-BEVS），这是一种稀疏恢复学习方法，无需额外数据或架构修改即可同时提升干净数据准确率和抗损坏鲁棒性。我们的方法基于逐层权重大小识别剪枝候选，应用随机剪枝创建多样化的稀疏模型，并以随机采样的学习率对每个模型进行再训练。通过将这些多样化的恢复模型平均合并为单个稠密模型，我们在引入零推理开销的同时，增强了对各种损坏的鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出SR-BEVS稀疏恢复学习方法，通过随机剪枝创建多样化稀疏模型并将其平均融合，在不增加额外数据和推理开销的前提下，同时提升相机BEV 3D目标检测的干净准确率和抗损坏鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: SR-BEVS enhances both clean accuracy and corruption robustness of camera-based BEV 3D object detection by randomly pruning weight models, retraining them with diverse learning rates, and averaging them into a single dense model with zero inference overhead.
